items.q: He had a guy like Henry "Red" Allen... Because he had what call pyorrhea.

ctx.x: Well, how was he playing at that time, in your estimation? I mean, was he starting to show some of the physical problems with his gums or with his embrochure that were to really hamper him very late in life?

That's when he come to have three or four more, extra trumpet players, because he couldn't make, couldn't play... He had other guys playing for him. He had a guy like Henry "Red" Allen, Louis Metcalf on some of them, and Ward Pinkett on some of them. Because he had what call pyorrhea.
